programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Economía con Ciencia de Datos
programme_name_en: Master in Economics with Data Science
language_of_instruction: "Language of instruction: English" (UA programme page, verbatim). Admission page: "Applicants must have a good command of English, as the program is taught entirely in this language."
language_requirement: "English certificate (optional)" in the pre-enrolment document list — no minimum level (B2/C1) stated. No Spanish requirement stated.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 (page 'Precios Públicos Universitarios' last updated 01/06/2026; rates set by Decreto 101/2024 del Consell + anexo III update DOGV 19/09/2025)
non_eu_surcharge: YES — DOUBLE. Verbatim (UA public-price page): "Al estudiantado extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquellos a quienes les sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, se les aplicará el doble de los precios públicos establecidos en el Anexo I para los servicios académicos universitarios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del 100% del coste del servicio académico (Real Decreto 101/2024. art.6)." For a Tunisian non-resident: 35,34 x 2 = 70,68 EUR/ECTS -> 4.240,80 EUR for 60 ECTS (1st enrolment).
entry_requirements: Degree giving access to master's in the issuing country. For a non-EHEA degree without homologación: "Non-recognised degree certificates shall require a technical report showing an equivalence statement issued by the University of Alicante (Student Service Access Unit), for which the corresponding fee should be paid." Admission profile: "students with a solid quantitative foundation, particularly those with degrees in Economics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or other disciplines with a strong quantitative focus." Pre-enrolment pre-form requires passport, degrees, transcripts, motivation letter, CV, optional English certificate, plus TWO recommendation letters sent directly to qed@ua.es. Admission criteria weighting: grades 60% / reference letters 30% / other merits 10%.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. The admission profile names "Engineering" among the target degrees.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT, field 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0). The UA admission page states no applicant-level complementos for this master; it does require a UA equivalence report for non-EHEA degrees.
credit_recognition_available: YES in principle — UA has a full Credit Recognition and Transfer regime on the admission page (recognition of credits from official studies at other universities at the discretion of the Master's Academic Committee; 75% credit-volume/content/competence thresholds; work experience up to 15% of the curriculum; TFM can never be recognised). NOT FOUND: any specific advanced-standing rule for a 300-ECTS 5-year foreign degree.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. Published 2026-27 cycle (verbatim, UA): "Las personas interesadas en solicitar plaza en alguno de los estudios oficiales de Máster Universitario en la Universidad de Alicante deberán presentar su solicitud del 16/03/2026 al 26/06/2026, hasta las 14 horas. Período extraordinario: a partir del 17/07/2026 se activará únicamente en aquellos Másteres que no hayan cubierto todas las plazas."
application_rounds: 2026-27 extraordinary: from 17/07/2026, only for masters with places left
non_eu_early_round_advised: NOT FOUND as a stated rule, but non-EHEA applicants must obtain a UA equivalence technical report (paid, separate procedure) before/at admission — apply in the earliest round.
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS: 42 compulsory + 12 optional + 6 TFM (RUCT breakdown). Core: economic theory, data science and quantitative/econometric methods. Optional blocks (3 ECTS each): Group 1 — Behavioral Economics, Financial Economics, Modelling Economic Time Series, Program Evaluation, External Academic Internship 1; Group 2 — Labor Economics, Modelling Risk in Finance and Macroeconomics, Macroeconometrics for Policy Analysis, Topics in Applied Microeconomics, External Academic Internship 2. Replaces the phased-out Máster in Quantitative Economics; first implemented 2025-26.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Departamento de Fundamentos del Análisis Económico (DFAE) / Faculty of Economics and Business Sciences. Coordinator Pedro Albarrán. Linked to the Quantitative Economics Doctorate (QED), a European PhD network.
industry_links: External Academic Internship offered as an optional course (2 x 3 ECTS). Career framing: economic consultancy, data-driven business decision-making, policy evaluation in government/think tanks/international organisations.
thesis_or_internship: TFM 6 ECTS compulsory; internships optional (3 ECTS each, up to 2).

scholarships_internal.name: Full tuition-fee scholarships for outstanding candidates
scholarships_internal.detail: Verbatim: "Scholarships: Outstanding candidates are eligible for scholarships covering the full costs of tuition fees."

scholarships_internal.name: Fully funded QED doctorate access
scholarships_internal.detail: "Top master's graduates are offered fully funded access to the Quantitative Economics Doctorate (QED)" (UA news item announcing the master).

notes: ARITHMETIC: 35,34 EUR/ECTS x 60 = 2.120,40 EUR (EU/resident rate, 1st enrolment). Non-EU non-resident: 70,68 x 60 = 4.240,80 EUR. RUCT: MECES 3, Máster RD 822/2021, verificación 12/12/2024, BOE 01/10/2025 and 27/10/2025, Resolución Favorable Acreditación Institucional 18/07/2025; ects 42 obl + 12 opt + 6 TFM. Programme page states 'Curriculum: BOE 15/10/2025' and 25 places (number-of-places table on the admission page still shows course 2025-26 = 25). STRONG CANDIDATE for this applicant: fully English-taught, engineering background explicitly welcomed, full-tuition scholarships advertised, and a funded PhD route. UA web.ua.es returns HTTP 503 to WebFetch; all pages were retrieved with curl and a normal browser user-agent (HTTP 200) and read in full — this is primary-source content from the university's own domain, not a search index.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Tecnologías de Análisis de Datos Masivos: Big Data
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Big Data Analysis Technologies
institution: Universidad de Murcia (UMU) — INTERUNIVERSITY with Universidad de Santiago de Compostela (USC)
city: Murcia (Facultad de Informática) — joint title also taught at USC, Santiago de Compostela
language_of_instruction: "Idioma: Español" — verbatim from the UM programme page header (Centro: Facultad de Informática / Tipo de enseñanza: Presencial / Idioma: Español / Duración: 40 semanas / Créditos ECTS: 60 / Plazas de nuevo ingreso: 12 / Interuniversitario: Universidad de Murcia (UMU) y Universidad de Santiago de Compostela (USC)). SPANISH-ONLY. No English strand is offered.
language_requirement: No language certificate requirement published. Competence T4 is only "Conocimiento de otras lenguas, sobre todo la inglesa" as a learning outcome, not an entry condition. Spanish is required in practice.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2023-24 rates (Decreto n.º 8/2024, de 1 de febrero, BORM 10/02/2024) — this is the price order UM's own matrícula page still links as at 2026-08-25; no newer decree is published there. Rates for 2026-27 / 2027-28 are NOT PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND as an applied rate. The governing decree PERMITS it but does not impose it. Verbatim (Orden/Decreto n.º 8/2024 de la Región de Murcia, art. 6.5, linked from UM's own matrícula page): "Las universidades podrán diferenciar el precio del crédito hasta cubrir el 100 por 100 de los costes de las enseñanzas universitarias de grado y máster cuando se trate de estudiantes extranjeros mayores de dieciocho años que no tengan la condición de residentes, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquéllos a quienes sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, sin perjuicio del principio de reciprocidad." UM publishes no differentiated non-EU credit price, so whether it exercises this power is NOT FOUND — a human must confirm with postgrado@um.es before budgeting.
entry_requirements: Access: Spanish/EHEA degree giving access to master's, OR a non-EHEA degree without homologación provided the university first verifies an equivalent level of training (UM's Comprobación del nivel de formación equivalente procedure, to be requested BEFORE the admission process). Entry profile, verbatim: "El máster está destinado principalmente a graduados en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Física, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones y otras Ingenierías. También está enfocado a profesionales de empresa." Access degrees listed: Informática, Física, Matemáticas, Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica, Industriales, otras áreas de ciencias — "sin que exista prelación entre ellas". Programming prerequisite, verbatim: "Aunque no se asumen conocimientos previos en Tecnologías de Gestión y Análisis de Datos Masivos, se requiere que los solicitantes tengan competencias en programación básica y, en particular, en algún lenguaje programación (por ejemplo, C, Java, Fortran, Python o Matlab)." Only 12 new-entry places. Admission under the Reglamento de Postgrado Oficial de la UMU, decided by the Comisión Académica, prioritised on academic record.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT and emphatic. Ingeniería Informática is the first named target degree and the programming prerequisite is exactly this candidate's strength.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT — 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0 for 4315427). No applicant-level complementos are imposed on a computing/engineering entrant; the only prerequisite stated is basic programming competence, which is satisfied.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND at programme level. UM runs a general 'Reconocimiento de créditos' service (https://www.um.es/web/estudios/utilidades/reconocimiento-creditos) and the price decree charges 25% of fees for recognised/convalidated credits, but no advanced-standing rule for a 300-ECTS 5-year foreign degree is published. NOTE the plan has no optional credits at all (42 obligatorias + 18 TFM), which leaves little room for recognition in practice.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. UM's published 2026-2027 master admission calendar (verbatim headings): Fase I - presentación de solicitudes 'Del 10 de marzo al 22 de abril'; Fase II 'Del 1 al 30 de junio'; Fase Extraordinaria 'Del 30 de julio al 3 de septiembre'. Provisional lists 30 April / 13 July / 8 September; definitive lists 12 May / 17 July / 11 September; matrícula 12-14 May / 17-20 July / 11-14 September.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — REQUIRED IN EFFECT. A holder of a non-homologated foreign degree must request the 'Comprobación del nivel de formación equivalente de estudios universitarios extranjeros ajenos al EEES' BEFORE the admission process ("deberán solicitar, con antelación al proceso de admisión"), resolved by the Comisiones de Ramas de Conocimiento. With only 12 places, Fase I (March-April) is the realistic target.
admissions_contact_email: postgrado@um.es (Sección de Postgrado, Edf. Rector Soler 3ª planta, Campus de Espinardo, 30100 Murcia); cau@um.es for portal issues
curriculum_summary: Verbatim from the plan de estudios page: "El plan de estudios consta de 9 materias y un Trabajo Fin de Máster (TFM). No se contemplan materias optativas ni prácticas en empresas. Esto da lugar a una oferta académica de 60 ECTS (18 ECTS del TFM y 42 ECTS de las materias obligatorias)." Four modules: Big Data, Ciencia de Datos, Aplicaciones de Negocio, Trabajo Fin de Máster. Specific competences cover distributed/large-scale computation, cloud execution of big-data applications, text and web mining, classification and search over massive unstructured repositories, regression/classification modelling, visualisation, IoT sensor-network data analytics, and choice of database/data paradigm on efficiency, scalability and fault-tolerance criteria. "El Máster tiene una orientación eminentemente investigadora."
notable_faculty_or_lab: Facultad de Informática, Universidad de Murcia, jointly with Universidad de Santiago de Compostela (CiTIUS environment on the USC side). NOT FOUND: named individual faculty on the pages read.
industry_links: NONE built into the plan — "No se contemplan materias optativas ni prácticas en empresas". Research-oriented; business-application module is taught, not placement-based.
thesis_or_internship: TFM 18 ECTS (RUCT: 42 obligatorios + 18 TFM, 0 prácticas). No internship.

De igual modo, tendrán acceso quienes hayan cursado el título de Grado en Educación Primaria Mención en Música." The only widening is: "De igual forma se podrá reservar 4 plazas, cuando queden vacantes de las solicitudes que están relacionadas directamente con la Música, para casos especiales de solicitantes que están indirectamente vinculados con la música como los casos de estudios de Arte Dramático". Selection when oversubscribed: expediente académico 30% / CV matched to the entry profile 50% / interview 20%, with explicit extra weight for membership of the Conservatorio Superior de Música de Murcia teaching staff. 25 places.
accepts_engineering_background: NO — EXPLICIT BY EXHAUSTIVE LIST. The access document enumerates only music (and, for 4 reserved places, dramatic-art) qualifications. A Software Engineering degree is not among them, and a working music-producer/DJ career is not an accredited 'Título Superior de Música'. Treat as effectively closed unless the Comisión Académica exercises criterion (c) 'cualquier otro criterio ... que permita constatar la idoneidad del solicitante'.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 4312059). No applicant-level complementos scheme is published; the access route is by qualification type, not by bridging credits.

curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS = 42 obligatorias + 18 TFM (RUCT); no optional credits, no internships. MUSICOLOGY / MUSIC-RESEARCH content, not music technology: research methodology in music, musicology and ethnomusicology, history of instruments and repertoire, transcription/arrangement study, performer physiology and psychomotor development, artistic creative-performative research, and practical-analytical music research. The only technical touchpoints are CET 9 "Dominar los fundamentos físico-acústicos relacionados con la música" and CET 10 "Saber reconocer el componente matemático de la música" — acoustics and music-mathematics, NOT MIR, signal processing or machine learning.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Joint venture of the Universidad de Murcia (Facultad de Educación) and the Conservatorio Superior de Música de Murcia under an agreement with the Comunidad Autónoma de la Región de Murcia (Consejería de Educación y Cultura).
industry_links: NONE. Research/academic orientation; explicit purpose is "facilitar el acceso a la investigación y la posibilidad de iniciar estudios de doctorado".
